sample_space.description: Grinding chamber holds one large grinding vial, one mid-size vial, four standard grinding vials, or four microvial sets (product page). Vials: 'consist of a center cylinder, two end plugs, and an impactor' (SPEX Handbook p.53). Capacities: small vial 'actual volume with impactor, approximately 25 ml'; large vial 6801 'Sample capacity up to 50 mL (1 - 100 g)'; mid-size 6881 'up to 25 mL (1-40 g)'. Sample range 0.1-50 g per run. Pre-cool and grind in one step. Vial outer dimensions not published.

notes: CG-400 = SPEX item 6875 (same 52x55x46 cm, 20 kg specs appear in the SPEX 14th Edition Handbook p.49 for the 6875). Single grinding chamber in the lid: a dual-electromagnet coil housing hangs into an insulated LN2 tub; the closed vial sits inside the coil, fully immersed, and the steel impactor is shuttled magnetically end-to-end at the programmed cps (the mill's only moving part; the user-facing 'rate' is back-and-forth cycles per second, so 10 cps = 20 impacts/s per the sibling 6770 manual, https://isolab.ess.washington.edu/resources/manuals/SPEX_Cryo_Mill.pdf). LN2 level sensor shuts the mill down when low; auto-fill (6875A/CG-450) is NOT fitted in this configuration. Touchscreen controller stores 20 programs, dual USB. No vacuum, no magnet spec, no sample electrical connections. Render: box cabinet with lid, LN2 pool at 77 K with boil-off vapour, one cylindrical vial in a coil with an oscillating impactor (8-15 Hz).
